call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Consumables Surging to $20.8M & Revio Installed Base Utilization
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Christian, consumables came in very strong at $20.8M, up 23.5% YoY. Are you seeing an inflection in utilization across your population genomics customers, and how should we project Revio pull-through heading into 2027?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Christian Henry (CEO) answered: 'Our consumable revenue of $20.8M was driven by record HiFi sequencing volume. As customers scaled their projects with our new SPRQ chemistry and larger genome initiatives like Verily and TychoBio gained momentum, sample throughput reached all-time highs. We expect consumable pull-through to remain durable as customers transition from validation to full production.'

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Cash Burn Trajectory & Path to 2028 Breakeven
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: With cash and investments at $199.4M and quarterly operating burn at $34.9M, can you walk us through the cadence of expense reductions that get PacBio to cash flow breakeven without external financing?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Christian Henry responded: 'We have executed structural restructuring that eliminated over $75M in annualized operating costs, reflected in our OpEx coming down to $50.5M this quarter. As Vega shipments scale and gross margins expand toward 40% with higher consumable attach, our quarterly cash burn will decline sequentially toward -$20M in 2027 and reach breakeven by 2028. We are fully focused on managing our $199.4M liquidity fortress.'

call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Christian, regarding the announcement that Jim Gibson is stepping down as CFO to take an advisory role, can you give context on the transition timing and what qualifications you are prioritizing in the next finance chief?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Christian Henry stated: 'Jim has been a terrific partner through our restructuring and asset rationalization. With our major cost-cutting programs implemented and the company on a stabilized operational footing, Jim and the board felt this was the natural time to transition. Jim will remain actively advising through March 2027, ensuring a seamless handover while we conduct a comprehensive search for our next commercial-phase CFO.'
